The '''Sweepstakes''' was an annual [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stassia]]. It was immensely popular, but known for the terrible [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] crashes and fatalities. Local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] offered triple pay to any [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who helped with crowd control duties.
